Array.prototype.find()

The find() method returns the first element that satisfies the testing function. If no values satisfy it, undefined is returned.

Return value

The first element in the array that satisfies the provided testing function. Otherwise, undefined.

Options

OptionTypeDefault
signalAbortSignalnull
timeoutnumberDefault: null
parsefunctionNaN-safe

Comparing with NaN always returns false.
